Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
 Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
 We are looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer to join our team in Romania!
 About the Team 
 The team is made up of enthusiastic professionals that work in an international environment adapting to ever-evolving context and learning new technologies and parts of Deutsche Banks’ businesses. We oversee a high-frequency, low-latency Order and Execution Management system, supporting Private Bank business lines across multiple regions. We are not afraid of getting our hands dirty for whatever needs to be done to provide best product to our users and enable them to execute their tasks swiftly and reliably.
 On your first day, we will expect you to have: 
Ability to work with modern frameworks and tools (springboot 2 and 3), ability to analyse and learn;
Understanding of asynchronous communication patterns and event-driven architecture JMS/Kafka/RabbitMq/IBMMQ/Solace;Knowledge of TeamCity/Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, GIT, GCP, Kubernetes;
Knowledge of TeamCity/Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, GIT, GCP, Kubernetes;
SQL, Bash, Linux basic knowledge;
Java programming language min v8 (Spring/Quarkus, Hibernate, Junit) and NodeJS (ExpressJS, Jest);
Rest API;
Quarkus for deployment in Kubernetes
Frontend: Practical experience with React or Angular (component architecture, state management, forms).
Desire and ability to learn, debug and investigate across complex system landscape;
Strong analytical skills;
In-depth understanding of SDLC;
Adobe Experience Manager would be a plus;
Excellent communication skills in English.
 Nice to have:
Experience in Capital Markets, preferably Trading systems;
Design Patterns;
Experience with supporting live critical systems;
FIX Protocol.
Basic knowledge in other programming languages/Frameworks like Node / python;
 Throughout your journey within our team, we expect you to develop, demonstrate and apply both soft and technical skills: 
 Thinking:
Seek out relevant information from a number of different sources and validate the information credibility as a basis for solutions.
Use existing concepts and problem solving processes and generates workable alternatives and does so at different times (serially rather than in parallel) from a personal perspective.
 Engaging:
Actively listen and use open questions to understand the views of others. Seek to achieve common consensus on topics and issues.
Seek out opportunities to collaborate, contribute to communities, and actively develop self as well as help others to develop skills, capabilities, and best practice.
 Influencing:
Influence through strong, fact and benefit-based proposals.
Conduct clear communication that is understood by many audiences.
Make decisions quickly, based on information to hand, and therefore demonstrate confidence in your views and position.
 Achieving:
Be responsive to issues and take necessary action and follow planned activities effectively.
Consider how technology can create business value and consider cost in delivering solutions. Actively experiment to learn.
 Designing:
Design solutions with limited supervision using common design patterns and a range of design tools & techniques.
Conduct reviews with peers to ensure designs are fit for purpose, flexible, extensible, re-usable and compliant with all relevant DB design standards.
 Delivering:
Deliver high quality complex solutions end to end autonomously across a range of technologies.
Influence standards, working practices, tools and solutions across the team and be emerging as an expert in one or more technical domains.
Drive automation of the delivery process.
Positively impact team effectiveness.
 Operating:
Have a good working knowledge of operate solutions and services and identify areas to minimize toil.
Undertake investigations and increasingly lead remediation; analyze services and components.
 Controlling:
Recognize the key elements of security, risk and control, and investigate and report on issues and potential risk events within the engineering designs and solutions in your area.
Continue to learn and consequently strengthen your designs & solutions.
 Benefits: 
 • 1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform (possibility of choosing flexible benefits like meal tickets, medical coverage for employees and dependents at Regina Maria, private pension, sport subscription, etc.)
 • 25 vacation days/year.
 • Life Insurance cover.
 • Eyeglasses cost reimbursement: 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years
 • Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
 • In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
 • Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
 • Internal trainings and certifications.
